completionPolicy: No completion, attempt or achievement is created by changing views.

title: From joined rows to totals per customer
goal: Predict left-join rows, group them by customer reference, and retain a customer with no requests.

prerequisites.text: You need the Клиенты catalog, ЗаявкаУслуги document and the idea of a reference as record identity. These belong to your training service from earlier lessons, not a working database.
You need SELECT/FROM/WHERE and query parameters, covered in the preceding topic.
You need variables, arrays and calls to a server common module. Preparation gives exact properties and the frame; if your infobase setup is unknown, start there.

sections.title: What the report must show
paragraphs: The report must show request minutes for each of two selected customers, including a customer without requests. A correct grand total alone is insufficient: both distinct customer records must survive. We will inspect rows before adding them.

A and B are short labels for two different references in the training infobase. They are not real addresses or literal values to enter in a reference field. Both customers have the same displayed name “Service”. A name helps a reader but does not make two records identical.

sections.title: Rows before the query
paragraphs: There are two customer rows. Both request rows reference A, with durations 30 and 45. Customer B has no request. The Ключи parameter contains exactly the two newly created training references A and B, limiting this exercise to its own data. We do not select unrelated records by matching names.

sections.title: Join: find matches for each left row
paragraphs: К and З are short table aliases. К.Ссылка=З.Клиент matches requests to this customer record. Two matches for A produce two rows, not one row with a total. The left join then retains B: there is no match, but the left row remains.

The right fields for B contain NULL: there is no matching value in the query result. This is not a zero-minute document, an empty reference or Неопределено. Row order is not guaranteed without ORDER BY; the table below is arranged by our labels for readability.

code.source:
ВЫБРАТЬ
    К.Ссылка КАК Клиент,
    З.Ссылка КАК Заявка,
    З.ДлительностьМинут КАК Минуты
ИЗ
    Справочник.Клиенты КАК К
        ЛЕВОЕ СОЕДИНЕНИЕ Документ.ЗаявкаУслуги КАК З
        ПО К.Ссылка = З.Клиент
ГДЕ
    К.Ссылка В (&Ключи)

trace: The second match adds another row.
The left join retains the unmatched customer.

sections.title: Now choose the result level: one row per customer
paragraphs: GROUP BY К.Ссылка collects rows with the same customer reference. Group A has 30+45=75 minutes. Group B has no request duration. This report’s contract displays 0 when the sum is absent; ЕСТЬNULL(...,0) states that replacement explicitly.
Summation follows the join. We can see which rows belong to each group, so 75 and 0 have an explanation. Obtaining one number 75 and displaying two true flags would not replace this walkthrough.

code.source:
ВЫБРАТЬ
    К.Ссылка КАК Клиент,
    ЕСТЬNULL(СУММА(З.ДлительностьМинут), 0) КАК Минуты
ИЗ
    Справочник.Клиенты КАК К
        ЛЕВОЕ СОЕДИНЕНИЕ Документ.ЗаявкаУслуги КАК З
        ПО К.Ссылка = З.Клиент
ГДЕ
    К.Ссылка В (&Ключи)
СГРУППИРОВАТЬ ПО
    К.Ссылка

clarifications.title: An additional request and the number of groups
clarifications.text: If the first reference receives another 15-minute request, the detail result grows to four rows, while there are still two groups: A/90 and B/0. Request count changes the sum and joined row count, but creates no new customer reference. This is a separate variation after the main experiment, not another mandatory entry step.

sections.title: Two ways to lose the required result
paragraphs: INNER JOIN keeps matches only. The B row disappears, leaving only A/75. The query can be syntactically valid while failing the requirement to show every selected customer.

Grouping only by К.Наименование merges A and B, because their names match. The total 75 may look plausible while the two identities have been lost. Check group count and totals for the specific references, not just a grand total or label.

sections.title: Transfer to your own training data
paragraphs: Practice uses different references X/Y and durations 10/20. Predict the joined rows and both totals first, then compare them with actual 1C output. Use the link back to the joined-row table; your draft remains in this tab.

clarifications.title: When adding a condition on requests
clarifications.text: WHERE filters the rows produced by the join. Requiring a positive duration on the right rejects the NULL row and loses the unmatched customer. Place conditions according to the task and explicitly retest the empty customer when adding such a filter. The current report has no such extra condition.

selfcheck.prompt: CustomersX andY exist. X has one 10-minute request; Y has none. Join and group by reference. What changes if LEFT is replaced by INNER?
feedback: Correct: an inner join does not retain an unmatched row.
That is the left join result with the missing sum replaced by 0.
One matching request gives one detail row forX.

selfcheck.prompt: X andY share the name “Workshop”. X has 10- and 20-minute requests; Y has none. Why is checking only the grand total 30 insufficient?
options: Incorrect grouping by name can also give 30 while mergingX andY.
A matching name proves a matching reference.
Any total of 30 proves the join is correct.
feedback: Correct: you need two distinct references withX/30 andY/0.
The reference identifies the record; names can coincide.
A grand total may miss a lost or merged group.

selfcheck.prompt: Write the three left-join rows forX:10/20 andY: no requests. Explain whereY/0 comes from.
selfcheck.feedback: Check the NULL row, grouping by reference and explicit replacement of the absent sum. Free text is not graded automatically.

practice.title: A report for two different training customers
practice.task: In a separate synthetic infobase, create two new references X andY with the same name “Workshop”. X has 10- and 20-minute requests; Y has none. Obtain detail join rows, then one total row per reference. After the first result, change the first duration from 10 to 15 and rerun both queries.
practice.environment: Installed official training 1C and a separate training-service infobase with Клиенты, Услуги, СтатусыЗаявки and ЗаявкаУслуги. Use only newly created synthetic references.

Grouping retains two distinct references: initiallyX/30 andY/0, thenX/35 andY/0.
